policy: A feature is production-ready only when CI proof, automated tests, staging proof, observability, real user-flow proof, and rollback/recovery proof are all present. Exposed production features without proof must fail verification.

features.name: Frontend Boot
features.notes: Frontend now renders a tested operations dashboard surface instead of a title-only shell, fetches health/readiness/inventory APIs on load, and fails closed without showing demo inventory when backend or tenant context is unavailable. Real authenticated SaaS UI flows still require Playwright and staging proof.

features.name: Frontend Product UX
features.notes: Operations dashboard, backend health/readiness/inventory API loading, live inventory rendering from /api/vehicles, fail-closed inventory blocking when dealership context is missing, lead workflow blocking, scrape proof state, and tenant/readiness signals have automated frontend tests. This is not yet an authenticated user flow, Playwright flow, or staging-proven product UX.

features.name: Health, Readiness, Metrics, Version
features.notes: Modular and legacy health, readiness, metrics, and version route contracts exist. Live Render and staging proof still required.

features.name: Production Gates
features.notes: Build-time guardrails exist and now verify GitHub Actions workflows opt into the Node 24 JavaScript actions runtime, avoid deprecated Node 20 action major pins before GitHub's June 2, 2026 enforcement date, and keep Render Docker build filters tied to package-lock.json. Keep expanding gate checks as features are certified.

features.name: Render Staging Deploy Proof
features.notes: CI has a gated Render staging proof path that verifies health, readiness, and deployed commit when explicitly enabled. Render Docker build filters now include package-lock.json so deterministic dependency changes trigger service rebuilds. It remains disabled and not certified until GitHub variables are configured and the job runs green against the live Render staging service.

features.name: Authentication and Login
features.notes: Must not be called production-ready until session/JWT/reset/rate-limit/protected-route tests exist.

features.name: VIN Validation Foundation
features.notes: VIN format/check-digit validation, model-year-aware NHTSA decode calls, tenant-scoped decode cache behavior including mismatched cache payload bypass, NHTSA response VIN identity checks, NHTSA 50-record batch boundaries, generated-CARFAX-link labeling, provider disagreement metadata, manager VIN enrichment route wiring to the production decoder, manual/external vehicle write VIN guard behavior, external delete-by-VIN/destructive bulk sync VIN validation, manager appraisal VIN lookup validation, manager market-pricing auto-save VIN validation, and scrape validation fail-closed behavior for any invalid scraped VIN, missing scraped identity/price facts, invalid scraped identity values, non-positive/non-numeric scraped price facts, or invalid scraped mileage/odometer facts are covered by automated tests. Live provider staging proof, operational rate-limit monitoring, rollback proof, and real user-flow proof remain required.

features.name: Olympic Hyundai Scraper
features.notes: Extraction tests prove relative image URL normalization, non-http image URL filtering, missing year/make/model source facts are not fabricated, extracted Olympic Hyundai facts map into the dedup storage contract, and scraper storage integration failures are returned as errors instead of hidden console-only warnings. Enhanced scrape pipeline tests prove disabled validation or disabled vehicle deduplication fail closed without active inventory writes. Scrape validation now fails closed and sends failure/quality alerts when any scraped VIN fails full format/check-digit validation, even if the overall VIN-validity ratio is otherwise above the old threshold, and it rejects scraped vehicles missing year/make/model identity facts, carrying invalid year/make/model identity values, missing required price facts, carrying non-positive/non-numeric price facts, or carrying invalid mileage/odometer facts before the scrape can be treated as valid. Shared dedup storage tests now prove invalid scraped VINs, invalid source facts, and invalid source URLs are skipped before insert/merge, incomplete new scrape records do not become active inventory, scrape merge updates/deletes carry dealership scope, scrape merges cannot drop manually curated inventory photos, and unsafe/non-http scraped image URLs are filtered before active inventory writes. Live pagination, source-truth reconciliation, quarantine tables/admin review, observability, and staging proof remain required.

features.name: Robust Scraper
features.notes: Compiles and fails closed. Generic scrape entrypoints reject unconfigured scrape calls instead of returning empty/null success-shaped results. Browserless scrape persistence now writes through the existing vehicle deduplication path with the source dealership boundary, dedup skips are counted as skipped rather than fake updates, and sourceId lookups/status updates carry dealership scope when a dealership context is provided. Robust scrape completion/failure updates and scrape queue item reads/writes require the recorded dealership boundary. Manual single-vehicle scrape diagnostics, manual scraper sync, and test badge routes require auth, explicit integration permissions, and dealership context; external scrape trigger routes are sensitive-limited and manual sync uses the resolved dealership instead of a body-selected dealership id. Dealership scrape-source updates strip immutable ownership fields at both the route and storage layers. Super-admin Browserless, ZenRows, Zyte, Apify, and robust scrape provider status/test/trigger routes require explicit integration permissions. Not certified as a working scraper.

features.name: Facebook Marketplace Posting
features.notes: Modular and legacy Facebook Pages routes require explicit integrations read/write RBAC, including priority vehicle reads/writes, tenant-scoped provider page lookups, tenant-scoped token updates, and disconnect miss handling. Modular and legacy Facebook posting account/template/queue/schedule/OAuth/manual-post/config routes require messages read/write permissions and dealership context before storage. Modular page/account/template/queue create/update payloads strip client-supplied id, userId, dealershipId, createdAt, and updatedAt fields before storage, and scoped Facebook storage updates strip immutable ownership fields as defense in depth. Facebook account, template, queue, AI generation, manual-post marker, photo, manager autopost queue, config, super-admin Facebook Catalog config/test/sync, super-admin Marketplace settings/account/queue/listing/activity/process routes, and salesperson-owned marketplace account/queue/listing routes require explicit permissions and dealership context before storage. Super-admin Marketplace auth/verify/process routes are sensitive-limited. Salesperson-owned marketplace account ownership checks include the resolved dealership. Marketplace posting must remain draft/human-approved until token, duplicate, image, posting, and failure tests exist.

features.name: AI Lead Response
features.notes: AI prompt management routes require explicit ai.configure RBAC and dealership context where dealership-scoped, including the legacy admin prompt template write path. AI runtime generation routes require explicit ai.use RBAC, AI settings and FB inbox auto-send controls require ai.configure RBAC, and public chat fails closed without dealership context. Still needs inventory-grounding, finance guardrail, prompt injection, escalation, human approval, observability, staging, and real user-flow proof.

features.name: GHL CRM Sync
features.notes: GHL/API-key integration routes now require explicit integrations read/write RBAC and dealership context, including dealership webhook-secret reads/regeneration and test email sends; public CTA send, chat handoff, and chat lead auto-sync routes fail closed without dealership context before CRM writes; GHL mutation routes are restricted to master users until write flows are certified. Still needs OAuth, token refresh, webhook verification, sync log, duplicate-contact, staging, observability, rollback, and real user-flow proof.
